title: Using `related` with reverse M2M relation leads to AttributeError: 'ManyRelatedManager' object has no attribute 'field'
author: ento
body_preview: **Describe the issue** Cannot make a recipe that uses `related` to populate the reverse side of a M2M relation.  https://github.com/model-bakers/model_bakery/commit/2164e9d79b43af95a991829294eaa693041a3627 last touched the line that raises `AttributeError`.  **To Reproduce** See test case in this branch: https://github.com/model-bakers/model_bakery/compare/6519ce2538785ca1c5615456ffa06f6f4505866b....
